summary: Add scripts/evidence-keygen, which makes a host's own evidence signing key and signer configuration for hosts we trust

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this adds a developer script and documentation only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. No key is listed and no skip policy admits the new trust level; every check stays enforce false.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product; the script is new and nothing calls it.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change. A host owner runs the script when a key is wanted, and its public line is listed in .st/evidence-keys by a separate pull request.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
